audit.scope: Second editorial/source-boundary audit of saved Pala narrative, 19 October mapping and new organisational leads. Stable original papers reused; not freshly reread or independently corroborated.

findings.finding: Regional ensemble and dated award/event/repertoire claims remain source-specific; no universal cast count, founding year or current booking claim found in the maintained narrative.

Public article does not yet explain digital circulation or differentiate media publishers, troupes, councils and research foundations. New dossier supports a later bounded section with carefully labelled links.
Shared booking contact supports the CT13T004 lead, but no primary document names Dash as founder, president, secretary or trustee.
Recent Facebook photographs inspected include AI-content labels and unrelated devotional-event banners. They do not establish institutional office or serve as independent documentary evidence.
Social followers, views and video counts are mutable platform counters, not unique audience, statewide participation, revenue or impact.

The source workspace records a 12 October Dash2011 PDF recovery after disabling TLS verification; the project dossier records secure-fetch failures. Preserve both histories. The source-workspace recovery is not fresh secure verification or independent corroboration; current public form explanation already uses Patra2017.
New research retained in KB; no website narrative or media rights changed by this follow-up.
